name: method-relaxed-muon
preserved: CYCLE sharing: one block of shared layers, norms included, runs `passes` times in stack order with no independent prelude or coda.
Every visit of every shared layer owns a LoRA on q, k, v and out.
Each LoRA adds B A x to W' x with no alpha scaling; the loop-l LoRA is used only at loop l.
Zero initialization: B = 0 and Gaussian A, so training starts at the plain Recursive Transformer; every parameter, shared or LoRA, trains.
Fixed depth, full BPTT and terminal CE.
adaptations: 6 shared layers x 2 loops at P2 geometry (width 1280, 10 heads, 1 KV heads, 129 experts top-8, attention LoRA rank 160); the paper's Gemma 2B (18 layers as 9 shared x 2 loops), TinyLlama 1.1B (22 layers) and Pythia 1B, each with two looping blocks (Gemma also three), are not reproduced.

Training starts from random weights instead of uptraining a pretrained Gemma, TinyLlama or Pythia, so Stepwise/Average/Lower looped-layer and truncated-SVD LoRA initializations do not apply; LoRA.svd_init provides eq. 4 for converted full-size weights.
A draws from the common normal(init_std) rather than an unstated Gaussian.
Every FFN is a shared top-k expert bank; routers and routed experts take no LoRA, so only attention is relaxed.
MoE path: balance loss coefficient 0.01, the repo default; the paper has no MoE.
One rank for all attention projections replaces the paper's per-component rank ablation (Table G.1).

Track P2's Muon for hidden matrices (AdamW for embedding, head, routers, norms and other 1-D parameters), schedule and run settings replace the paper's uptraining settings (AdamW, LR 2e-4, cosine, SlimPajama, context 2048, about 2M-token batches).
Early exit and continuous depth-wise batching (Section 2.4) are outside this selected path.
Publicly reconstructible DCLM replaces the original private corpus; the frozen manifest and tokenizer are separate comparison identities.
Common RMSNorm/RoPE/SwiGLU cells, softmax top-k with selected-weight normalization and dropless dispatch.

Track P2's Muon for hidden matrices (AdamW for embedding, head, routers, norms and other 1-D parameters) and independently owned input embedding/output head; no original-paper quality or scaling claim.

Geometry: 6 shared layers instead of 4 give m0's 12 logical layers (6 x 2), LoRA rank 160 keeps the constructor's rank/width ratio of 1/8 at width 1280, and 129 experts per layer meet m0's unique parameters.

Matrix initialization std=.02 and unit norm scales are P2's; seq 4096, 1,048,576 positions per update, the schedule (95-update linear warmup, constant peak, last 20% linear to 0) and the AdamW or Muon settings are Track P2's; the training recipe (objective, depth, aux coefficient, expert LR multiplier) is the constructor's.
